question: What is the sex ratio in India according to the census 2011 ?
solution:
***In the Population Census of 2011, it was revealed that the population ratio in India 2011 is *****943***** females per 1000 of males.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__****Sex-ratio:**

 
• The sex ratio is used to describe the number of females per 1000 males.
 
• Sex ratio is a valuable source for finding the population of women in India and what is the ratio of women to that of men in India.
 
• In the Population Census of 2011, it was revealed that the population ratio in India 2011 is 940 females per 1000 males.
 
• The Sex Ratio 2011 shows an upward trend from the census 2001 data. Census 2001 revealed that there were 933 females to that of 1000 males.
 
• For decades India has seen a decrease in the sex ratio 2011, but since the last two of the decades, there has been a slight increase in the sex ratio.
 
• Since the last five decades, the sex ratio has been moving from around 930 females to that of 1000 males.

***Hence, the correct answer is 943 females per 1000 males.***
